headline: Leadership transition remains near-term monitorable

highlights: Deposit growth is expected to outpace advances, helping moderate the CD ratio, which has declined to ~89% in 2QFY27 from ~92% in 4QFY26.  Margins contracted sharply by 55bp QoQ to 6.69% in 2QFY27, primarily due to surplus liquidity and higher funding costs.

Management guides for an 18-20bp NIM recovery by 4QFY27 as liquidity is deployed, although further deposit repricing could exert near-term pressure.  Operating leverage is expected to improve gradually, supported by healthy business growth and improving productivity.
We estimate credit cost of ~1.3% over FY27-28E.  Management raised FY27 RoA guidance to ~1.35% from ~1.2% while targeting ~1.5% in FY28.

watch: Balaji Nuthalapadi, currently WTD, as interim CEO (subject to RBI approval) does provide near-term stability, the appointment of the new MD remains the key driver for recovery in the stock.
While the impending MD & CEO transition remains a key monitorable, management expects no disruption to business continuity.  At current valuations of 0.9xFY28E ABV, valuations appear reasonable.
